desc: AR-15 Pistol Buffer Tube Complete Assembly (PBT-CA) by Phase 5 Weapon Systems Inc. partners their enhanced buffer spring, billet aluminum Pistol buffer tube, Mil-Spec end plate, Mil-Spec castle nut, Mil-spec carbine buffer and their ultra-durable NPVC-constructed buffer tube foam pad. The lower slot is machined to accept all Mil-Spec end plates and sling mounting accessories.
